selection.method: Bounded patient-isolated sequential forward selection, fixed LR C1; no hyperparameter search
selection.nesting: Each original outerFIT divided into3 patient-held-out assessment groups. Within remaining patients deterministically split60percent selection-training,20percent threshold-calibration,20percent feature-choice. Greedy path trained only on selection-training; threshold only calibration; subset score only feature-choice. Each cardinality then refits on selection-training+feature-choice, calibration still excluded; evaluate untouched assessment. Original Development and ownOuter excluded throughout.
selection.probe: LogisticRegression C1 lbfgs max_iter1000 tol1e-6, patient-equal inverse class weighting; original patientZ, own-subFIT imputer/scaler; no raw labels repeated per window
selection.threshold: Calibration only, EZ probability grid0to1 step0.005, original patientMacroF1/EZF1/nearest0.5/lower tie semantics
selection.cardinality_choice: On ownFIT assessment patient means, utility minus0.1 source utility sampleSD; choose smallest k within0.005 of maximum, then higher score. Diagnostic8/9 may be selected if materially better; no forced7D/6D.
selection.final_subset: Repeat fixed greedy procedure on deterministic60/20/20 split of complete ownFIT, take chosen k. No cross-fold global winning subset. Consensus/frequency is descriptive only, not new evaluated fixed subset.
selection.replacement: Among all single-coordinate group swaps of own final subset, choose highest same-k feature-choice utility; never reselect from Development/Outer. RandomA/B use two fixed seed42/fold/k draws before outcomes, no rerolling. Exact identical subsets are aliases, not independent fits.
selection.stability: Selection frequency over15 assessment paths and5 final paths, cardinality-conditioned Jaccard and chance-adjusted overlap. Overlapping training sets are not independent replication; no global selection from these frequencies. Report full path/search record and fixed budget.
selection.original7: Unchanged original7 as a reference, not privileged default or required final subset
